final_announce: Announce: relevant=[object 2]; rule=The device turns on if object 2 is placed on the device, regardless of other objects.
Announce: relevant=[object 5]; rule=the device turns on if object 5 is present and no objects with numbers greater than 5 are present.

Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 4]; rule=The device turns on when object 1 is placed with or without other objects, and when object 4 is placed alone, but turns off if both are placed together or if any other object is placed alone.
Announce: relevant=[object 2, object 7]; rule=The device turns on when either object 2 or object 7 is placed alone or with other objects, but turns off if both are placed together.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3]; rule=The device turns on when at least three of the objects 0, 1, 2, and 3 are placed together.
Announce: relevant=[object 0]; rule=The device turns on if object 0 is placed on it.
Announce: relevant=[object 5, object 6]; rule=The device turns on if and only if either object 5 or object 6 is placed on it, but not both.
Announce: relevant=[object 4, object 6]; rule=The device turns on if exactly one of object 4 or object 6 is placed on it.
Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 5]; rule=The device turns on when either object 1 or object 5 is placed, but turns off if both are included.
Announce: relevant=[object 2, object 6]; rule=The device turns on when either object 2 or object 6 is placed, but turns off if both are placed together.
Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 4]; rule=the device turns on if object 1 is placed with object 4, but turns off if objects 0 or 2 are also present
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 7]; rule=The device turns on if exactly one of object 0 or object 7 is placed.

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3]; rule=The device turns on if object 2 or object 3 is placed alone, if at least two of object 0, object 1, and object 2 are placed together, or if object 3 is combined with object 0 or object 1. It turns off if both object 2 and object 3 are included in the set, regardless of other objects. Other objects have no effect.
Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 5]; rule=The device turns on when either object 1 or object 5 is placed, but turns off if both are included.
Announce: relevant=[object 3, object 6, object 7]; rule=the device turns on if object 3, object 6, and object 7 are all present, but only if object 0 is not included.

Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 7]; rule=The device turns on if either object 1 or object 7 is placed on it alone or with other objects, but turns off if both object 1 and object 7 are placed together.
